tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[A quasilinear elliptic PDE] 1. ch9:9.2-ex-2\group Fixed Point Theorems Consider the semilinear boundary-value problem \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u + b(Du) + \mu u = 0 & \text{in } U \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U, \end{cases} \tag {21} \] where $U$ is bounded with smooth boundary and $b:\R ^n\to \R $ is smooth and Lipschitz, hence \[ |b(p)| \le C(|p| + 1) \tag {22} \] for some constant $C$ and all $p \in \R ^n$. \end{example}
